text: In the mid-nineteenth century, Lizzy and Isaac Macklin have left St. Louis to settle on the western frontier when a younger couple, Emma and Gideon Harper, [move into the abandoned cabin nearby|trigger|an outsider reaches in]. Lizzy, who once lost a stillborn son, grows close to Emma, until the pregnant Emma claims [a demon is coming for her child|wants|a child to take or have] and shoots herself. Left alone when the men ride off for supplies, Lizzy feels [her old fear of demons return|threat|the devil and dark gods] and finds, in the Harpers' empty cabin, [a diary full of Emma's secrets|images|books, letters and writing].
